licence: Textures.com material, licensed to whoever downloads it. Its terms forbid redistribution, open-source projects included. Keep the downloads and everything converted from them outside Git and out of every pak; generate_pbr_showcase_map.py writes only below an ignored runtime root.
dropFolder: Put each material's files (or its zip) in <source-dir>/<id>/. File names only need to contain the map name: Albedo, Normal, Roughness, Metallic, Ambient Occlusion, Alpha, Height.

materials.title: Brushed Stainless Steel
materials.exercises: Bare metal with directional micro-scratches in normal and roughness: highlight streaking and specular anti-aliasing.

materials.title: Polished Brass
materials.exercises: Smooth coloured conductor: tinted F0 reflections from probes and the ambient environment.

materials.title: Dented Gold
materials.exercises: Strong relief on a near-mirror metal: normal-map aliasing and roughness filtering at distance.

materials.title: Paint Rusted 3
materials.exercises: Metallic mask: bare metal and paint/rust dielectric side by side in one material.

materials.title: Metal Treadplate Bare
materials.exercises: Raised metal relief on a floor under a grazing projector: normal orientation and shadowing.

materials.title: Glazed Wall Tiles
materials.exercises: Glossy glaze against rough grout: roughness contrast and reflection blur.

materials.title: Polished Cream Marble Slab
materials.exercises: Smooth bright dielectric with no metal or AO map: Fresnel at grazing angles, scalar defaults.

materials.title: Plain Leather
materials.exercises: Fine pore normals at mid roughness; no metallic map (scalar 0).

materials.title: Fabric Linen
materials.exercises: Very rough, high-frequency weave: diffuse energy and moire at distance.

materials.title: Polypropylene Plastic 2
materials.exercises: Smooth saturated dielectric: white specular over coloured diffuse.

materials.title: Sci-Fi Industrial Panel 2
materials.exercises: Quake 4-style mixed panel: hard-edged metal masks and deep seams beside stock-looking content.

materials.title: Stretched Metal Fence
materials.exercises: Alpha-tested cutout metal in front of the projector: cutout coverage, two-sided shading and cutout shadow casting (PCSS penumbra on the floor).

materials.title: Maple Wood Floor
materials.exercises: Large receiving floor: shadow quality, contact hardening and SSAO on a real surface.

materials.title: Mixed Medieval Brick Wall
materials.exercises: Deep relief and AO behind the stations: indirect occlusion and normal-mapped receivers.

materials.title: Patterned Concrete Wall
materials.exercises: Rough side walls and ceiling: neutral surround for the stations, grazing point-light shadows.
